summary: Good unit test coverage and structure validation, but thin integration testing. The suite has ~22 unit tests covering all matrix_generator.py logic (cartesian product, exclude/include rules, size validation, CLI, error handling) and comprehensive workflow structure tests (YAML parsing, actionlint, path existence, triggers, jobs, dependencies). However, only 2 integration test cases run end-to-end through act (via run_act_tests.py), despite the task requirement that 'every single test case must execute through GitHub Actions workflow via act.' Edge cases (oversized matrix, malformed JSON, empty dimensions) are well-tested in unit tests but not validated through the actual workflow pipeline. The test design is clean with good organization, clear naming, and sound fixture usage, but integration coverage is a significant gap. Would catch regressions in isolated logic but may miss workflow-specific edge cases.
